messages:
rebecca: Quick sync notes from product9am chat with Beta customers. They want multi-region isolation options + predictable billing. Can we outline realistic MVP scope?
dan: High-level options: 1) soft isolation (logical quotas + strict admission control), 2) semi-hard (dedicated pools for tiered customers), 3) full physical silo. We should prefer 1->2 path.
nisha: Important: soft isolation must guarantee deterministic tail behavior (we need absolute P99 caps per-tenant). Otherwise customers still ask for silos.
tom: Runtime constraints: we can enforce per-tenant request tokens, per-tenant KV namespaces, and per-slice batching knobs. Cost impact estimate: soft isolation ~+12-22%, semi-hard ~+40-80%.
kevin: Launch criteria idea:
- Functional: per-tenant KV separation boolean flag, routing policy available as API
- Perf: P95 delta <= +20ms, P99 delta <= +40ms vs baseline
- Cost: median uplift <25% for default soft iso config
- Reliability: no cross-tenant OOM propagation in 95% of chaos runs
- Observability: per-tenant metrics (latency histograms, cache hit/spill rates)
nisha: Pilot plan: pick 4 tenants (smoke, small, medium, large) across 2 regions, test 3 model families (L1, L2, L3). Run 72h steady traffic + burst windows.
rebecca: Good. Also need product gating: docs, tenant opt-in flow, billing signal, and clear customer comms about limits. Sales wants a short feature one-pager.
dan: Policy sketch (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
routing_policy: tenant_affinity
parameters:
  admission_control:
    max_concurrent: per_tenant(threads=20)
  batch_isolation: true
  kv_namespace: tenant_id
  fallback_order:
    - compatible_quantized_model
    - pooled_elastic_fallback
```
kevin: Add a flag `strict_cache_isolation: true` that disables shared prefix caching and forces per-tenant caches. Useful for semi-hard/premium customers.
tom: Ops test checklist:
- replay production traces for each tenant size
- inject cache pressure and validate eviction rate ceilings
- simulate region failover and ensure affinity respects residency rules
- define rollback triggers (example: sustained P99 > baseline + 100ms for 5m)
neisha: Telemetry: we need new labels on metrics: tenant_id, slice, region, model_id. Also add a spill_reason tag for cache evictions.
rebecca: Prioritization note: aim to ship soft isolation + admin UI controls in Q2, semi-hard in Q3 as paid tiers, full physical silos only for enterprise on contract. Keep API backwards compatible.
dan: Risk log: policy combinator explosion, scheduling hard with mixed tenancy, billing complexity. Mitigations: limited initial policy set, shared scheduler heuristics, billing preview in console.
kevin: Pricing suggestion: base product includes soft isolation. "Isolation Premium" add-on unlocks strict_cache_isolation + region-pinned pools. Charge a monthly fixed + usage multiplier.
rebecca: Action items:
- @dan: write short tech brief + migration compatibility matrix by Tue EOD
- @nisha: test matrix + telemetry schema by Wed
- @tom: SRE runbook + rollback hooks by Thu
- @kevin: one-pager pricing + sales bullets by Thu
- @rebecca: draft customer comms + admin UI mockups by Fri
ops-bot: Reminder: link RFC template https://redwood.infra/rfcs tag=multi-tenant-isolation. Auto-create ticket if PR created.
rebecca: Thanks. We'll present this MVP approach to Beta cluster stakeholders next Wed. Keep the scope minimal and measurable. :raised_hands:
